snippet.title: Safe Safe Revolution - Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming December 18th, 2018.

You’ve found a safe. You want to know what’s inside, but there’s a combination lock in the way. And it isn’t any old lock either… To break it open, you need to beat it at its own games! Can you crack this challenging catch?

Try to clear the lock’s challenges as quickly as you can. The fewer the mistakes you make, the higher your score! But be careful: the goal of each challenge is different every time. And the more you complete, the harder they get...
